name: Ana García Pérez
title: Junior Data Scientist
summary: Highly analytical Junior Data Scientist with a strong foundation in statistical modeling, machine learning, and data visualization. Eager to leverage data-driven insights to solve complex business problems and contribute to innovative projects. Proficient in Python for data analysis and predictive modeling.

bullets: Developed and deployed Python scripts for automated data extraction and transformation, reducing manual processing time by 20%.
Built predictive models using Scikit-learn to forecast customer churn, improving prediction accuracy by 15% for the marketing department.
Conducted A/B tests on new product features, providing insights that led to a 5% increase in user engagement.
Collaborated with engineering teams to integrate machine learning models into production systems, supporting over 100,000 daily users.
Performed SQL queries to extract and analyze data from large databases, supporting monthly business intelligence reports.
Created interactive dashboards in Tableau to visualize key performance indicators, enhancing data accessibility for 5+ internal teams.
Assisted senior data scientists in data cleaning and preprocessing tasks using Python's Pandas library for various projects.
Collected and meticulously organized large datasets for academic research projects, ensuring data quality for subsequent analysis.
Applied basic statistical methods in R to analyze experimental results, contributing to two published research papers.
Developed data collection protocols, improving efficiency by 10% for research surveys.
